name: U2 small nuclear RNA auxiliary factor 2

function.text: U2AF2 encodes splicing factor U2AF 65 kDa subunit). Annotated molecular activities include molecular function inhibitor activity and poly-pyrimidine tract binding. It participates in mRNA splicing, via spliceosome and positive regulation of RNA splicing.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to developmental delay, dysmorphic facies, and brain anomalies (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Acute Myeloid Leukemia. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; strong GenCC assertion from Ambry Genetics. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Cohort-level candidate sequence driver in IntOGen (combined q<0.1; at least 3 mutated samples). Statistical association does not classify an individual allele.
